title: Figure Releases Helix 2.5, 30 Strangers Successfully Achieve Zero-Shot with 56% Success Rate
summary: Figure released Helix 2.5, a humanoid robot neural network pretrained on Index human behavior data and tested in 30 unseen homes. Index pretraining raises zero-shot success from 9% to 56%. The single foundation model handles tidying living rooms, folding towels, and making beds; test environments and objects were unseen.....
